payload.credit_html: Platypterygius sp. (fossil ichthyosaur) (Cretaceous; Weston County, Wyoming, USA) 3
payload.description_html:
A fossil skull of Platypterygius, an Ichthyosaur, from the Cretaceous of Wyoming, USA. (public display, Sternberg Museum of Natural History, Hays, Kansas, USA).

It lived from the Early Cretaceous (Hauterivian) to the earliest Late Cretaceous (Cenomanian), 130–94.3 M.y.a
